name: olio.pb.locationProposal
label: Location Proposal
description: PictureBook V3 §7.1 / §28 step 3: one reviewable item from the whole-book location pass (pictureBook.cluster-locations). The pass clusters the scenes' settings into places and writes one PROPOSED row per place into the book's group, owned by the request user; nothing is resolved until a reviewer accepts the item, at which point getCreateLocation (or the sameAs merge) runs as the olio principal and the referenced scenes are re-pointed. 'name' is the slug of proposedName so the (name, groupId, organizationId) constraint keeps one proposal per place per book; 'passRun' marks which pass wrote the row so a re-run can retire stale PROPOSED rows without touching ACCEPTED/REJECTED ones. No field carries a schema default (PB2 convention rule 3, TestPbModelSchema): the enum columns read NULL as UNKNOWN.

fields.name: proposedName
fields.description: The place name the pass proposes; becomes the olio.pb.location name on accept.

fields.name: description
fields.description: The place as the pass summarized it from the referenced scenes' settings.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Other names the scenes use for the same place; folded into the resolved location's aliases on accept.

fields.name: sceneObjectIds
fields.description: objectIds of the olio.pb.scene rows the pass clustered under this place; re-pointed to the resolved location on accept.

fields.name: sameAs
fields.description: When set, the name or alias of an existing olio.pb.location in the book's world this proposal duplicates; accept resolves to that location instead of creating one.

fields.name: location
fields.description: The olio.pb.location the proposal resolved to; null until ACCEPTED.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Reviewer note on reject, or the accept path taken.

fields.name: passRun
fields.description: Identifier of the pass run that last wrote this row.
